description: Infinite Minds is a team of young developers, innovators, and space enthusiasts driven by curiosity and creativity. summary: An immersive, interactive Flutter-based space education platform where youth become Junior Astronauts, managing Mars base resources and making critical mission decisions in real-time.
details:
Infinite Minds: Project Details (Submission Ready)

Project Name: Infinite Minds: Junior Astronaut Space Mission Simulator

1. What does it do or how does it work?

Infinite Minds is an interactive Flutter-based space education platform. Its core feature, "Level 5: Mission Simulator," turns users into Junior Astronauts managing a Mars base for 30 Sols. Players balance 5 vital resources (Energy, Water, Food, Oxygen, Radiation Shield) through real-time emergency events (e.g., Solar Storms) where choices trigger direct consequences and performance reports.

2. What benefits and impact does it have?

It bridges the gap between aerospace concepts and youth education by fostering critical thinking, risk assessment, and resource management. By gamifying NASA's planetary exploration challenges, it inspires future scientists with fully bilingual (English/Arabic) accessibility.

3. Tools, Languages, & Technologies Used:

  • Framework & Language: Flutter & Dart (Cross-platform mobile/web)
  • State Management: Provider Pattern
  • Design: Dark space-themed UI, responsive layouts, and live progress indicators
  • Data Standards: NASA Mars Exploration Program & Human Research Program guidelines

4. Creativity & Design Factors:

Replaces static quizzes with a dynamic, consequence-driven decision engine. Key design factors include mobile-first responsiveness, strict type-safety, seamless bilingual localization, and high replayability through branching scenario paths.
